034/**
035 * Session for serializing objects to TOML format.
036 */
037@SuppressWarnings({
038   "resource",   // TomlWriter lifecycle managed by SerializerPipe
039   "rawtypes",   // Raw types necessary for generic type handling
040   "java:S110",  // Inheritance depth acceptable for serializer session hierarchy
041   "java:S115",  // Constants use naming conventions that embed type info or config keys (e.g. PROP_trimWhitespace)
042   "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for serialization logic
043   "java:S6541"  // Acceptable for session implementation
044})
045public class TomlSerializerSession extends WriterSerializerSession implements RecordWritable {

085   @Override /* RecordWritable */
086   public RecordWriter writeRecords(Object output) throws IOException {
087      return RecordAdapter.writer(this, output);
088   }
089
090   @Override /* RecordWritable */
091   public boolean isRecordStreaming() {
092      return false;
093   }
094
095   @Override
096   protected void doWrite(SerializerPipe out, Object o) throws IOException, SerializeException {
097      if (o == null)
098         return;
099      TomlWriter w = getTomlWriter(out);
100      writeRoot(w, o);
101   }
102
103   protected final TomlWriter getTomlWriter(SerializerPipe out) {
104      var output = out.getRawOutput();
105      if (output instanceof TomlWriter output2)
106         return output2;
107      var w = new TomlWriter(out.getWriter(), isUseWhitespace(), getMaxIndent(), isTrimStrings(), getUriResolver());
108      out.setWriter(w);
109      return w;
110   }
111
112   private void writeRoot(TomlWriter w, Object o) throws SerializeException {
113      ClassMeta<?> eType = getExpectedRootType(o);
114      if (eType.isBean()) {
115         writeBean(w, toBeanMap(o), "");
116      } else if (eType.isMap()) {
117         writeMapAtRoot(w, (Map<?,?>)o, eType);
118      } else if (eType.isCollection() || eType.isArray()) {
119         Collection<?> c = eType.isArray() ? toList(eType.inner(), o) : (Collection<?>)o;
120         ClassMeta<?> elType = eType.getElementType();
121         if (elType.isBean() || elType.isMap()) {
122            // Array of tables at root - use "item" as table name
123            for (Object item : c) {
124               w.blankLine();
125               w.arrayOfTablesHeader("item");
126               if (elType.isBean())
127                  writeBean(w, toBeanMap(item), "item");
128               else
129                  writeMapAsTable(w, "item", (Map)item, elType);
130            }
131         } else {
132            // Root array of simples: wrap in _value
133            w.bareKey("_value");
134            w.w(" = ");
135            writeArray(w, c, eType);
136            w.w('\n');
137         }
138      } else {
139         // Root primitive: wrap in _value
140         w.bareKey("_value");
141         w.w(" = ");
142         writeValue(w, o, eType);
143         w.w('\n');
144      }
145   }
146
147   private void writeMapAtRoot(TomlWriter w, Map<?,?> map, ClassMeta<?> type) throws SerializeException {
148      Predicate<Object> checkNull = x -> isKeepNullProperties() || nn(x);
149      forEachEntry(map, e -> {
150         String k = e.getKey() == null ? "null" : toString(e.getKey());
151         Object v = e.getValue();
152         if (!checkNull.test(v))
153            return;
154         ClassMeta<?> aType = getClassMetaForObject(v, type);
155         if (aType.isMap() && v instanceof Map<?,?> v2) {
156            w.blankLine();
157            w.tableHeader(k);
158            writeMapAsTable(w, k, v2, aType);
159         } else {
160            writeKeyValue(w, k, v, null);
161         }
162      });
163   }
164
165   private void writeBean(TomlWriter w, BeanMap<?> m, String tablePath) throws SerializeException {
166      Predicate<Object> checkNull = x -> isKeepNullProperties() || nn(x);
167      List<Map.Entry<BeanPropertyMeta,Object>> simple = l();
168      List<Map.Entry<BeanPropertyMeta,Object>> complex = l();
169
170      m.forEachValue(checkNull, (pMeta, key, value, thrown) -> {
171         if (nn(thrown))
172            onBeanGetterException(pMeta, thrown);
173         ClassMeta<?> cMeta = (ClassMeta<?>) pMeta.getBeanInfo();
174         if (canIgnoreValue(pMeta, key, value))
175            return;
176         ClassMeta<?> aType = value == null ? cMeta : getClassMetaForObject(value, cMeta);
177         if (isSimpleOrInlineTable(aType, value, pMeta)) {
178            simple.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<>(pMeta, value));
179         } else {
180            complex.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<>(pMeta, value));
181         }
182      });
183
184      if (ctx.sortKeys) {
185         simple.sort(Comparator.comparing(e -> e.getKey().getName()));
186         complex.sort(Comparator.comparing(e -> e.getKey().getName()));
187      }
188
189      // Pass 1: simple values and inline tables
190      for (var e : simple) {
191         String key = e.getKey().getName();
192         Object value = e.getValue();
193         BeanPropertyMeta pMeta = e.getKey();
194         writeKeyValue(w, key, value, pMeta);
195      }
196
197      // Pass 2: tables and array of tables
198      for (var e : complex) {
199         String key = e.getKey().getName();
200         Object value = e.getValue();
201         BeanPropertyMeta pMeta = e.getKey();
202         ClassMeta<?> cMeta = (ClassMeta<?>) pMeta.getBeanInfo();
203         String newPath = tablePath.isEmpty() ? key : tablePath + "." + key;
204
205         if (nn(value)) {
206            w.blankLine();
207            ClassMeta<?> aType = getClassMetaForObject(value, cMeta);
208            if (aType.isBean()) {
209               w.tableHeader(newPath);
210               writeBean(w, toBeanMap(value), newPath);
211            } else if (aType.isMap()) {
212               w.tableHeader(newPath);
213               writeMapAsTable(w, newPath, (Map)value, cMeta);
214            } else if (aType.isCollection() || aType.isArray()) {
215               Collection<?> col = aType.isArray() ? toList(aType.inner(), value) : (Collection<?>)value;
216               ClassMeta<?> elType = aType.getElementType();
217               // HTT: the `elType.isMap()` operand is provably dead here -- isSimpleOrInlineTable()
218               // (below) only excludes collection-of-BEAN elements from "simple" classification, so
219               // a collection-of-MAP property is always classified simple upstream and never reaches
220               // this complex-pass block at all. Consequently `elType.isBean()` is always true by the
221               // time control reaches here, making the `else` at line ~410 (writeMapAsTable(item)) also
222               // dead. See TomlSerializerSession_Test#j11 for a test documenting the resulting (buggy)
223               // stringify-via-toString() behavior for collection-of-map bean properties.
224               if (elType.isBean() || elType.isMap()) { // HTT: dead -- see comment above; elType is always a bean here, so this condition is unconditionally true (the isMap() operand and the implicit "both false" skip-to-else outcome are both unreachable)
225                  for (Object item : col) {
226                     w.blankLine();
227                     w.arrayOfTablesHeader(newPath);
228                     if (elType.isBean()) // HTT: dead -- see comment above; elType is always a bean here, so this condition's false-arm (the else below) is unreachable
229                        writeBean(w, toBeanMap(item), newPath);
230                     else
231                        writeMapAsTable(w, newPath, (Map)item, elType); // HTT: dead -- see comment above; elType is always a bean here
232                  }
233               } else {
234                  writeKeyValue(w, key, value, pMeta); // HTT: dead -- see comment above; the enclosing condition is unconditionally true, so this else-arm is unreachable
235               }
236            }
237         }
238      }
239   }
240
241   private void writeKeyValue(TomlWriter w, String key, Object value, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws SerializeException {
242      ClassMeta<?> cMeta;
243      if (pMeta != null)
244         cMeta = (ClassMeta<?>) pMeta.getBeanInfo();
245      else if (value != null)
246         cMeta = getClassMetaForObject(value);
247      else
248         cMeta = object();
249      ClassMeta<?> aType = value == null ? cMeta : getClassMetaForObject(value, cMeta);
250
251      // Apply swap
252      var swap = aType.getSwap(this);
253      if (nn(swap)) {
254         value = swap(swap, value);
255         aType = swap.getSwapClassMeta(this);
256         if (aType.isObject())
257            aType = getClassMetaForObject(value);
258      }
259
260      if (value == null && !isKeepNullProperties()) // HTT: dead -- every call site (writeMapAtRoot, writeMapAsTable, writeBean's simple/complex passes) already filters entries through its own "isKeepNullProperties() || nn(x)" predicate before calling writeKeyValue, so a null value can only ever reach here when isKeepNullProperties() is already true, making "!isKeepNullProperties()" always false
261         return; // HTT: dead -- see comment above
262
263      writeKey(w, key);
264      w.w(" = ");
265      if (value == null)
266         w.stringValue(ctx.getNullValue());
267      else
268         writeValue(w, value, aType, pMeta);
269      w.w('\n');
270   }
271
272   private static void writeKey(TomlWriter w, String key) {
273      if (w.isBareKey(key))
274         w.bareKey(key);
275      else
276         w.quotedKey(key);
277   }
278
279   @SuppressWarnings({
280      "unused",       // pMeta accepted for API consistency; may be used by future format-specific logic
281      "java:S1172"    // Same as above
282   })
283   private void writeValue(TomlWriter w, Object value, ClassMeta<?> aType, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws SerializeException {
284      if (value == null) {
285         w.stringValue(ctx.getNullValue());
286         return;
287      }
288      // Resolve to the runtime type and apply any registered swap.  Required for collection/array
289      // elements that arrive here without having gone through writeKeyValue's swap step (e.g.
290      // List<Locale> elements where the bean-property swap is on the List, not on Locale).
291      // Without this, Locale list-elements wire as Locale.toString() ("en_US") regardless of
292      // the configured LocaleFormat, breaking BCP_47 round-trips on the parser side.
293      var rType = getClassMetaForObject(value, aType);
294      var swap = rType.getSwap(this);
295      if (nn(swap)) {
296         value = swap(swap, value);
297         rType = swap.getSwapClassMeta(this);
298         if (rType.isObject())
299            rType = getClassMetaForObject(value);
300         aType = rType;
301      }
302      if (value == null) {
303         w.stringValue(ctx.getNullValue());
304         return;
305      }
306      if (aType.isBean()) {
307         BeanMap<?> bm = toBeanMap(value);
308         if (shouldUseInlineTable(bm)) {
309            w.inlineTableStart();
310            boolean[] first = {true};
311            Predicate<Object> checkNull = x -> isKeepNullProperties() || nn(x);
312            bm.forEachValue(checkNull, (pm, k, v, th) -> {
313               if (!first[0]) w.w(", ");
314               first[0] = false;
315               writeKey(w, k);
316               w.w(" = ");
317            writeValue(w, v, (ClassMeta<?>) pm.getBeanInfo(), pm);
318            });
319            w.inlineTableEnd();
320         } else {
321            writeBean(w, bm, "");
322         }
323      } else if (aType.isNumber()) {
324         if (value instanceof Float || value instanceof Double)
325            w.floatValue(((Number)value).doubleValue());
326         else
327            w.integerValue(((Number)value).longValue());
328      } else if (aType.isBoolean()) {
329         w.booleanValue((Boolean)value);
330      } else if (aType.isEnum()) {
331         w.stringValue(((Enum<?>)value).name());
332      } else if (aType.isDate()) {
333         w.w(writeDate((Date)value, aType));
334      } else if (aType.isCalendar()) {
335         w.w(writeCalendar(value, aType));
336      } else if (aType.isTemporal()) {
337         Class<?> inner = aType.inner();
338         if (inner == Year.class || inner == YearMonth.class)
339            w.stringValue(writeTemporal((TemporalAccessor)value, aType));
340         else
341            w.w(writeTemporal((TemporalAccessor)value, aType));
342      } else if (aType.isDuration()) {
343         w.stringValue(writeDuration((Duration)value));
344      } else if (aType.isPeriod()) {
345         w.stringValue(writePeriod((Period)value));
346      } else if (value.getClass().isArray()) {
347         // Generalized fallback: when aType arrives erased — most commonly
348         // because the value is a typed List<T[]> bean-property element and the parent List's
349         // elementType resolved to Object (getClassMetaForObject(value, cMeta) ignores the
350         // cMeta hint when value != null and returns the raw runtime ArrayList ClassMeta) —
351         // the isCollection/isArray dispatch below doesn't fire and the value would otherwise
352         // stringify via Object.toString() ("[B@<hash>", "[I@<hash>", …).  Detect the array
353         // shape from the runtime class and emit a TOML inline-array, recursing on each
354         // (boxed) element through writeValue so the per-element wire form (integer / float
355         // / bool / string) follows the standard dispatch.  Subsumes the byte[]-only fix that
356         // originally landed for the BinaryFormat.NOT_SET round-trip and extends it to
357         // int[]/long[]/short[]/float[]/double[]/boolean[]/char[]/String[]/Object[] (and any
358         // nested array shape via the recursive writeValue step).  At configured (non-NOT_SET)
359         // binary formats the per-property BinarySwap has already fired in writeKeyValue's
360         // swap step, so byte[] values reach this branch only at NOT_SET — a no-op for the
361         // configured-format paths.  Array.get auto-boxes primitive
362         // elements, so a single runtime-typed loop covers every primitive component type.
363         int len = Array.getLength(value);
364         w.arrayStart();
365         for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
366            if (i > 0) w.w(", ");
367            Object el = Array.get(value, i);
368            if (el == null)
369               w.stringValue(ctx.getNullValue());
370            else
371               writeValue(w, el, getClassMetaForObject(el), null);
372         }
373         w.arrayEnd();
374      } else if (aType.isCollection() || aType.isArray()) {
375         Collection<?> c = aType.isArray() ? toList(aType.inner(), value) : (Collection<?>)value;
376         ClassMeta<?> elType = aType.getElementType();
377         if (elType.isBean() || elType.isMap()) {
378            // Should have been handled in complex pass
379            w.stringValue(value.toString());
380         } else {
381            w.arrayStart();
382            boolean first = true;
383            for (Object el : c) {
384               if (!first) w.w(", ");
385               first = false;
386               if (el == null)
387                  w.stringValue(ctx.getNullValue());
388               else
389                  writeValue(w, el, elType, null);
390            }
391            w.arrayEnd();
392         }
393      } else {
394         w.stringValue(toString(value));
395      }
396   }
397
398   private void writeValue(TomlWriter w, Object value, ClassMeta<?> aType) throws SerializeException {
399      writeValue(w, value, aType, null);
400   }

402   @SuppressWarnings({
403      "unused",       // path and type reserved for future section-header and type-aware serialization
404      "java:S1172"    // Same as above
405   })
406   private void writeMapAsTable(TomlWriter w, String path, Map<?,?> map, ClassMeta<?> type) throws SerializeException {
407      Predicate<Object> checkNull = x -> isKeepNullProperties() || nn(x);
408      forEachEntry(map, e -> {
409         String k = e.getKey() == null ? "null" : toString(e.getKey());
410         Object v = e.getValue();
411         if (!checkNull.test(v))
412            return;
413         writeKeyValue(w, k, v, null);
414      });
415   }
416
417   private void writeArray(TomlWriter w, Collection<?> c, ClassMeta<?> type) throws SerializeException {
418      ClassMeta<?> elType = type.getElementType();
419      w.arrayStart();
420      boolean first = true;
421      for (Object el : c) {
422         if (!first) w.w(", ");
423         first = false;
424         writeValue(w, el, elType);
425      }
426      w.arrayEnd();
427   }
428
429   @SuppressWarnings({
430      "unused",       // pMeta accepted for API consistency with callers that track property context
431      "java:S1172"    // Same as above
432   })
433   private boolean isSimpleOrInlineTable(ClassMeta<?> aType, Object value, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws SerializeException {
434      if (aType.isBean()) {
435         BeanMap<?> bm = toBeanMap(value);
436         return shouldUseInlineTable(bm);
437      }
438      return !aType.isMap() && !(aType.isCollectionOrArray() && aType.getElementType().isBean());
439   }
440
441   private boolean shouldUseInlineTable(BeanMap<?> bm) {
442      if (!ctx.useInlineTables)
443         return false;
444      int count = 0;
445      for (BeanPropertyMeta p : bm.getMeta().getProperties().values()) {
446         if (!p.isReadOnly()) {
447            ClassMeta<?> cm = (ClassMeta<?>) p.getBeanInfo();
448            if (cm.isBean() || cm.isMap() || (cm.isCollectionOrArray() && cm.getElementType().isBean()))
449               return false;
450            count++;
451            if (count > ctx.inlineTableThreshold)
452               return false;
453         }
454      }
455      return count <= ctx.inlineTableThreshold;
456   }
